purpose: Track local source-context review for every current source anchor in the domain-source promotion queue, while keeping independent fresh review, card promotion and model admission gates explicitly closed.

scope.selectionRule: Review every current source anchor referenced by the 81 domain-source card promotion tasks before drafting reviewed Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards, transfer-boundary cards or downgrade checks.
currentLimitations: This is a local source-context review, not an external independent fresh reviewer verdict.

Reviewed anchors support method, taxonomy, value, mechanism, governance, preservation, time-accounting, bias and public-boundary vocabulary only; they do not validate domain data, model calibration, intervention effects or individual recommendations.

Rows remain blocked from model admission until independent fresh review, reviewed Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards, transfer-boundary cards, downgrade checks and later model gates pass.
Completion of local source-context review does not complete Source Card promotion, domain-claim upgrade, clinical validity, calibrated prediction or individual-level use.

localReviews.reviewedSourceTitle: Nonparametric estimation from incomplete observations

reviewEvidence.finding: HERO metadata identifies the source as a 1958 Journal of the American Statistical Association journal article by Kaplan and Meier, volume 53 issue 282, pages 457-481. The abstract describes incomplete observations, loss/censoring-like events, independence assumptions that require scrutiny, and nonparametric estimation of P(t).
The paper defines the survival function P(t) and product-limit estimate, and discusses losses, observation limits, and dependence between lifetimes and loss times.

supports: Aggregate survival-function and event-time accounting when time origin, event definition and censoring/loss rules are explicit.
Use as method vocabulary for survival curves and incomplete observations.
doesNotSupport: Individual prognosis or death-date output.
Intervention effect, causality, route feasibility, calibrated model validation, or personal recommendation.
localReviews.reviewerBoundary: Transfer only as survival curve, product-limit and incomplete-observation vocabulary. Requires separate cohort, endpoint, censoring and validation cards before any quantitative model use.
